reply_text:
I replied to Tobias in our direct message and confirmed his Marrow Agrisupply call is now Thursdays at 10:45. I didn't make any changes, since he said no action was needed.

I told him I can't save memories between conversations. The note stays in our DM history, so either of us can look it up there later. I also offered to put the calls on his calendar. The calendar tool can't make a repeating event, so each call would be added separately, starting with Thursday Oct 15 at 10:45. I asked how long the call runs, in case he wants that.
